summary: Recent changes in the Canvas area of the Firefox browser have focused on improving WebGL, the technology that allows for 3D graphics within web pages. This includes the removal of outdated checks related to the context's status, helping to streamline the performance of WebGL. Additionally, there are updates to support Metal ANGLE, which enhances graphics processing on macOS devices, ensuring better rendering and compatibility. Other improvements involve updating coding standards and removing deprecated configurations, contributing to a cleaner and more efficient codebase. **These enhancements will lead to a smoother graphics experience for users, especially when running complex visual applications or games online.**
